    *   B. *Post hoc ergo propter hoc*: This means "after this, therefore because of this". It's a cause-and-effect fallacy based on temporal sequence.
    *   C. *Argumentum ad populum*: This is an appeal to popularity ("If everyone thinks it's right, then it's right").
    *   D. *Ad hominem*: This means "to the person". It specifically involves attacking the opponent personally (character, motives, etc.) rather than the argument itself.
